patch:
diff --git a/main.py b/main.py
index 0000000..1111111 100644
--- a/main.py
+++ b/main.py
@@ -1,9 +1,93 @@
-class RestAPI:
-    def __init__(self, database: dict | None = None):
-        pass
-
-    def get(self, url: str, payload: str | None = None) -> str:
-        pass
-
-    def post(self, url: str, payload: str | None = None) -> str:
-        pass
+import json
+
+class RestAPI:
+    def __init__(self, database: dict | None = None):
+        self.database = database or {"users": []}
+
+    def get(self, url: str, payload: str | None = None) -> str:
+        if url == "/users":
+            if payload is None:
+                # Return all users
+                users = [self._user_object(user) for user in self.database["users"]]
+                users.sort(key=lambda u: u["name"])
+                return json.dumps({"users": users})
+            else:
+                # Return specified users
+                data = json.loads(payload)
+                user_names = data.get("users", [])
+                users = [self._user_object(user) for user in self.database["users"] if user["name"] in user_names]
+                users.sort(key=lambda u: u["name"])
+                return json.dumps({"users": users})
+        return json.dumps({})
+
+    def post(self, url: str, payload: str | None = None) -> str:
+        if url == "/add":
+            data = json.loads(payload)
+            name = data["user"]
+            # Check if user already exists
+            for user in self.database["users"]:
+                if user["name"] == name:
+                    return json.dumps(self._user_object(user))
+            # Create new user
+            new_user = {
+                "name": name,
+                "owes": {},
+                "owed_by": {}
+            }
+            self.database["users"].append(new_user)
+            return json.dumps(self._user_object(new_user))
+        
+        elif url == "/iou":
+            data = json.loads(payload)
+            lender_name = data["lender"]
+            borrower_name = data["borrower"]
+            amount = data["amount"]
+            
+            # Find lender and borrower
+            lender = None
+            borrower = None
+            for user in self.database["users"]:
+                if user["name"] == lender_name:
+                    lender = user
+                if user["name"] == borrower_name:
+                    borrower = user
+            
+            if lender is None or borrower is None:
+                return json.dumps({})
+            
+            # Update lender's owed_by and borrower's owes
+            # Update lender's owed_by
+            if borrower_name in lender["owed_by"]:
+                lender["owed_by"][borrower_name] += amount
+            else:
+                lender["owed_by"][borrower_name] = amount
+            
+            # Update borrower's owes
+            if lender_name in borrower["owes"]:
+                borrower["owes"][lender_name] += amount
+            else:
+                borrower["owes"][lender_name] = amount
+            
+            # Clean up zeros
+            if lender["owed_by"][borrower_name] == 0:
+                del lender["owed_by"][borrower_name]
+            if borrower["owes"][lender_name] == 0:
+                del borrower["owes"][lender_name]
+            
+            # Return updated users
+            updated_users = [self._user_object(lender), self._user_object(borrower)]
+            updated_users.sort(key=lambda u: u["name"])
+            return json.dumps({"users": updated_users})
+        
+        return json.dumps({})
+
+    def _user_object(self, user_data):
+        total_owed_by = sum(user_data["owed_by"].values())
+        total_owes = sum(user_data["owes"].values())
+        balance = round(total_owed_by - total_owes, 2)
+        return {
+            "name": user_data["name"],
+            "owes": user_data["owes"],
+            "owed_by": user_data["owed_by"],
+            "balance": balance
+        }
